name: Longshot fade
description: Taker strategy for NBA/NHL game-winner markets: during the game, at fixed checks, buy the favourite (= NO on the longshot) when a side trades below a price threshold. Tested whether retail overpays for comeback tickets.
hypothesis: Brief lead: takers buying sides under 20c in games lose 5-7c/contract. Idea: retail overpays for longshots so the favourite is underpriced late in games. Wrong if buying the favourite at the ask (gross of nothing, net of spread+fee) has CI<=0 over full dev history, clustered by game.
next: Rejected at research on 2,772 dev games (4 screens, none net-positive). Not piped: no screen beat spread+fee.
